# Galaxy UDT Implementation Reference

Read only the section needed for the current implementation or failure.

- [Minimal UDT](#minimal-udt)
- [Staged generated script](#staged-generated-script)
- [Short base64 fallback](#short-base64-fallback)

The YAML blocks are authoring examples. The API representation may be serialized
as JSON.

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a verified pinned tag. Use a bare tagged
reference without `docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  application-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

from collections import defaultdict, Counter
import numpy as np
vcf='inputs/vcf.infer.ancestry.q1.vcf.gz'
posfile='[REDACTED LOCAL PATH]'
url='https://ftp.1000genomes.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/ftp/release/20130502/ALL.chr1.phase3_shapeit2_mvncall_integrated_v5b.20130502.genotypes.vcf.gz'
# load target biallelic SNP genotypes
T={}  # (chrom,pos)-> (ref,alt,dosages list)
with gzip.open(vcf,'rt') as f:
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith('#'): continue
        fs=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        chrom,pos,ref,alt=fs[0],int(fs[1]),fs[3],fs[4]
        if len(ref)"'!=1 or len(alt)!=1: continue
        ds=[]
        ok=True
        for cell in fs[9:13]:
            gt=cell.split('"':',1)[0].replace('|','/')
            if '.' in gt: ok=False; break
            alle=gt.split('/')
            # biallelic only; skip if genotype references non-first alt
            if any(a not in ('0','1') for a in alle): ok=False; break
            ds.append(sum(1 for a in alle if a=='1'))
        if ok:
            T[(chrom,pos)]=(ref,alt,ds)
print('target_biallelic_simple', len(T), file=sys.stderr)
# sample names
samples=subprocess.check_output(['bcftools','query','-l',url], text=True).splitlines()
N=len(samples)
print('ref_samples',N,file=sys.stderr)
# arrays per target: called sites, dist, matches, het/hom components
called=np.zeros((4,N), dtype=np.int32)
dist=np.zeros((4,N), dtype=np.int32)
exact=np.zeros((4,N), dtype=np.int32)
opp_hom=np.zeros((4,N), dtype=np.int32)
used=0; flip_used=0; skipped_allele=0
cmd=['bcftools','query','-R',posfile,'-f','%CHROM\\t%POS\\t%REF\\t%ALT[\\t%GT]\\n',url]
p=subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1024*1024)
for line in p.stdout:
    fs=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    if len(fs)<5: continue
    chrom,pos,ref,alt=fs[0],int(fs[1]),fs[2],fs[3]
    key=(chrom,pos)
    if key not in T: continue
    tref,talt,tds=T[key]
    # skip multiallelic ref line unless one alt and same alleles; allow swapped ref/alt
    if ',' in alt or len(ref)"'!=1 or len(alt)!=1:
        continue
    if ref==tref and alt==talt:
        target=tds; flip=False
    elif ref==talt and alt==tref:
        target=[2-d for d in tds]; flip=True
    else:
        skipped_allele+=1; continue
    gts=fs[4:]
    if len(gts)!=N:
        print('"'bad sample count', len(gts), file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(2)
    rdos=np.empty(N, dtype=np.int16)
    mask=np.ones(N, dtype=bool)
    for i,gt in enumerate(gts):
        if '.' in gt:
            mask[i]=False; rdos[i]=0; continue
        a=re.split(r'[|/]',gt)
        if any(x not in ('0','1') for x in a):
            mask[i]=False; rdos[i]=0; continue
        rdos[i]=(1 if a[0]=='1' else 0)+(1 if a[1]=='1' else 0)
    for j,td in enumerate(target):
        diff=np.abs(rdos-td)
        called[j,mask]+=1
        dist[j,mask]+=diff[mask]
        exact[j,mask]+=(diff[mask]==0)
        if td in (0,2):
            opp_hom[j,mask]+= (diff[mask]==2)
    used+=1
    flip_used+=int(flip)
ret=p.wait()
stderr=p.stderr.read()
print(stderr[:2000], file=sys.stderr)
print('used_sites',used,'flip',flip_used,'skipped_allele',skipped_allele, file=sys.stderr)
# load panel
panel_url='https://ftp.1000genomes.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/ftp/release/20130502/integrated_call_samples_v3.20130502.ALL.panel'
panel_text=subprocess.check_output(['curl','-fsSL',panel_url], text=True)
pop={}; superpop={}
for line in panel_text.splitlines()[1:]:
    ss=line.split('\\t')
    if len(ss)>=3:
        pop[ss[0]]=ss[1]; superpop[ss[0]]=ss[2]
# report top 20 each, plus aggregate median dist by superpop
for j in range(4):
    idx=np.argsort(dist[j]/np.maximum(called[j],1))[:20]
    print('\\nTARGET',j+1,'called min/max',called[j].min(),called[j].max())
    print('rank sample pop superpop called dist rate exact_rate opphom')
    for rank,i in enumerate(idx,1):
        s=samples[i]
        rate=dist[j,i]/called[j,i]
        er=exact[j,i]/called[j,i]
        print(rank,s,pop.get(s,'?'),superpop.get(s,'?'),called[j,i],dist[j,i],f'{rate:.5f}',f'{er:.5f}',opp_hom[j,i])
    # aggregate nearest by superpop: mean rate of top 25 in each
    groups=defaultdict(list)
    for i,s in enumerate(samples):
        if called[j,i]>0: groups[superpop.get(s,'?')].append(dist[j,i]/called[j,i])
    print('superpop_rate_min_median_mean')

import gzip, subprocess, sys, math
from collections import defaultdict
vcf='inputs/vcf.infer.ancestry.q1.vcf.gz'; posfile='[REDACTED LOCAL PATH]'
url='https://ftp.1000genomes.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/ftp/release/20130502/ALL.chr1.phase3_shapeit2_mvncall_integrated_v5b.20130502.genotypes.vcf.gz'
T={}
with gzip.open(vcf,'rt') as f:
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith('#'): continue
        fs=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        chrom,pos,ref,alt=fs[0],int(fs[1]),fs[3],fs[4]
        if len(ref)"'!=1 or len(alt)!=1: continue
        ds=[]; ok=True
        for cell in fs[9:13]:
            gt=cell.split('"':',1)[0].replace('|','/')
            if '.' in gt: ok=False; break
            alle=gt.split('/')
            if any(a not in ('0','1') for a in alle): ok=False; break
            ds.append(sum(a=='1' for a in alle))
        if ok: T[(chrom,pos)]=(ref,alt,ds)
cmd=['bcftools','query','-R',posfile,'-f','%CHROM\\t%POS\\t%REF\\t%ALT\\t%INFO/AFR_AF\\t%INFO/EUR_AF\\t%INFO/EAS_AF\\t%INFO/SAS_AF\\t%INFO/AMR_AF\\n',url]
p=subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1024*1024)
pops=['AFR','EUR','EAS','SAS','AMR']
ll=[[0.0 for _ in pops] for _ in range(4)]
count=[[0 for _ in pops] for _ in range(4)]
used=0; flip=0; skipped=0
for line in p.stdout:
    fs=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    if len(fs)<9: continue
    chrom,pos,ref,alt=fs[0],int(fs[1]),fs[2],fs[3]
    key=(chrom,pos)
    if key not in T or ',' in alt: continue
    tref,talt,tds=T[key]
    if ref==tref and alt==talt:
        d=tds
    elif ref==talt and alt==tref:
        d=[2-x for x in tds]; flip+=1
    else:
        skipped+=1; continue
    afs=[]
    for x in fs[4:9]:
        try: afs.append(float(x))
        except: afs.append(None)
    for si,td in enumerate(d):
        for pi,af in enumerate(afs):
            if af is None: continue
            # small floor to avoid exact zero from finite reference panel
            q=min(max(af,1e-4),1-1e-4)
            if td==0: prob=(1-q)*(1-q)
            elif td==1: prob=2*q*(1-q)
            else: prob=q*q
            ll[si][pi]+=math.log(prob)
            count[si][pi]+=1
    used+=1
p.wait(); err=p.stderr.read()
print(err, file=sys.stderr)
print('used',used,'flip',flip,'skipped',skipped)
print('sample\\t'+'\\t'.join(pops)+'\\tbest')
for si in range(4):
    per=[ll[si][pi]/count[si][pi] for pi in range(len(pops))]
    best=pops[max(range(len(pops)), key=lambda i: per[i])]
    print(f'Sample{si+1}\\t'+'\\t'.join(f'{x:.6f}' for x in per)+f'\\t{best}')

import gzip, sys, re, subprocess
from collections import defaultdict
import numpy as np
from cyvcf2 import VCF
vcf_in='inputs/vcf.infer.ancestry.q1.vcf.gz'
ref_vcf='[REDACTED LOCAL PATH]'
T={}
with gzip.open(vcf_in,'rt') as f:
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith('#'): continue
        fs=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        chrom,pos,ref,alt=fs[0],int(fs[1]),fs[3],fs[4]
        if len(ref)"'!=1 or len(alt)!=1: continue
        ds=[]; ok=True
        for cell in fs[9:13]:
            gt=cell.split('"':',1)[0].replace('|','/')
            if '.' in gt: ok=False; break
            alle=gt.split('/')
            if any(a not in ('0','1') for a in alle): ok=False; break
            ds.append(sum(a=='1' for a in alle))
        if ok: T[(chrom,pos)]=(ref,alt,np.array(ds, dtype=np.int16))
print('targets',len(T), file=sys.stderr)
vcf=VCF(ref_vcf)
samples=vcf.samples; N=len(samples)
dist=np.zeros((4,N), dtype=np.int32); called=np.zeros((4,N), dtype=np.int32); exact=np.zeros((4,N), dtype=np.int32)
used=flip=skip=0
for var in vcf:
    key=(var.CHROM, var.POS)
    item=T.get(key)
    if item is None: continue
    tref,talt,tds=item
    if len(var.REF)"'!=1 or len(var.ALT)!=1 or len(var.ALT[0])!=1: continue
    alt=var.ALT[0]
    if var.REF==tref and alt==talt:
        target=tds
    elif var.REF==talt and alt==tref:
        target=2-tds; flip+=1
    else:
        skip+=1; continue
    gt=var.genotypes  # list [a,b,phased]
    arr=np.fromiter(((g[0]+g[1]) if g[0]>=0 and g[1]>=0 and g[0]<=1 and g[1]<=1 else -1 for g in gt), dtype=np.int16, count=N)
    mask=arr>=0
    for j,td in enumerate(target):
        d=np.abs(arr-td)
        dist[j,mask]+=d[mask]
        called[j,mask]+=1
        exact[j,mask]+=(d[mask]==0)
    used+=1
print('"'used',used,'flip',flip,'skip',skip, file=sys.stderr)
# panel
panel='[REDACTED LOCAL PATH]'
subprocess.run(['curl','-fsSL','-o',panel,'https://ftp.1000genomes.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/ftp/release/20130502/integrated_call_samples_v3.20130502.ALL.panel'], check=True)
pop={}; sp={}
for line in open(panel):
    if line.startswith('sample'): continue
    ss=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    if len(ss)>=3: pop[ss[0]]=ss[1]; sp[ss[0]]=ss[2]
for j in range(4):
    rates=dist[j]/np.maximum(called[j],1)
    order=np.argsort(rates)[:15]
    print('\\nSample',j+1,'used range',called[j].min(),called[j].max())
    print('rank\\tsample\\tpop\\tsp\\tcalled\\tdist\\trate\\texact')
    for r,i in enumerate(order,1):
        s=samples[i]
        print(f'{r}\\t{s}\\t{pop.get(s,\"?\")}\\t{sp.get(s,\"?\")}\\t{called[j,i]}\\t{dist[j,i]}\\t{rates[i]:.5f}\\t{exact[j,i]/called[j,i]:.5f}')
    groups=defaultdict(list)
    for i,s in enumerate(samples): groups[sp.get(s,'?')].append(rates[i])
    print('groups', ' '.join(f'{g}:min={min(v):.5f},med={sorted(v)[len(v)//2]:.5f}' for g,v in sorted(groups.items())))
